snippet.title: Achhi Baat Kaho Ya Khamosh Raho! Imaan Ki Pehchaan | Sahih Bukhari 6475 #shorts
snippet.description:
Ek chhoti si cheez... jo aap ke imaan ki pehchaan hai. Jaante hain woh kya hai?

Hazrat Abu Huraira Radi Allahu Anhu bayan karte hain, ke Hamare Nabi Muhammad-e-Mustafa (Sallallahu Ta'ala Alaihi Wa Aalihi Wasallam) ne farmaya:
«مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ لِيَصْمُتْ»
"Jo Allah par aur aakhirat ke din par imaan rakhta hai, woh achhi baat kahe ya khamosh rahe. Aur woh apne padosi ko takleef na de, aur apne mehmaan ki izzat kare."

Reference
• Sahih al-Bukhari 6475: https://sunnah.com/bukhari:6475

To aaj bolne se pehle, ek lamha rukein... kya yeh baat achhi hai? Agar nahin, to khamoshi behtar hai. Comment mein likhein: aaj main sirf achhi baat kahunga! Yeh video aage bhejein, yeh bhi ek aur sadqah hai. One more sadqah 🤍
